title: Consume European Firaga vertical lookup projection
changes: Extend the existing task-parameter vertical lookup projection by 11 signed halfwords without capping guest indices, preserving older representations and isolating usage accounting.
validation: Wine reader e339-firaga-vertical-extension-readers-wine-tzkb51gc checks previous resources and representations, source authentication, mixed boundaries and mirrors, isolated counters, 56 interpreted/generated reader cases, transfers and snapshot ownership.
Wine scene e339-firaga-vertical-extension-scene-wine-kf23c29b compares 606 altered-source frames and consumes all 11 new entries, matching state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio.

Wine CLI e339-firaga-vertical-extension-cli-wine-huxmebx6 creates, reuses and verifies 147 matching files; static join e339-firaga-vertical-extension-sample-residual-o6wga3mh leaves 83 unowned addresses in the E302 sample.
limitations: Other indices, callers and scenes, source-save history, real BIOS and UI save/Load remain open; the sample is address-only and does not establish a table bound.
Affected older revision-sensitive Wine fixtures need adaptation and rerun; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance comparison was made.
